title: Checkpoint harness verifier report
description: What one verifier invocation reports (Task 3 research log §6 and §12 T3-D). The controller runs one binding with PACTWRIGHT_BINDING and PACTWRIGHT_REPORT set; the verifier writes this document to PACTWRIGHT_REPORT with one result for each target of that binding it executed. Separate from the checkpoint contract format and the run configuration.

assertions.description: Assertions executed for this result; a pass needs at least one.

observations.description: Named observations; the binding lists the keys each result must carry.
